description: The headless time picker core of the SvGrid UI kit in Svelte 5. createTimePicker is the state machine behind SvTimePicker: hour and minute value math, 12 and 24-hour display, minute snapping, the pure dial geometry and the full keyboard, exposed as dialProps, segProps, ampmProps and nowProps. The same core drives the styled analog picker and a custom digital readout, both bound to one value.

faq.question: What is the dial geometry?
faq.answer: The core computes the angle and position of every number and of the hand for the current selection, so a render can draw the dial in SVG or CSS without trigonometry of its own.

faq.question: How does a digital render use the core?
faq.answer: It ignores the dial and uses segProps for hour and minute segments, which wire arrow keys and typing, plus ampmProps for the period toggle; the value stays shared with the analog picker.

faq.question: What does nowProps do?
faq.answer: It wires a button that sets the value to the current time, respecting minuteInterval snapping.
